integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained except standard Wiener-inverse and Fredholm facts; numerical illustration has no certification role; independently validated status is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The known exact norm and fine/ordinary spectrum are prior results. Different weights and other essential-spectrum conventions are not included. Complete text of a closely related earlier weighted-Hahn source was inaccessible, with resulting residual originality risk.
scientific_scope: Complex one-sided convolution on the unweighted dual Hahn norm space for absolutely summable coefficients, all finite approximation/Bernstein/Gelfand numbers, strictly singular/compact distances, Fredholm essential spectrum and index.
title: Flat operator-ideal profile and Fredholm boundary for dual-Hahn convolution
